## Live Discovery Results (2026-07-11)

Authenticated to `status.getkwikid.com:3001` via Socket.io login (user `root_user`) and extracted the full configuration. Method: EIO4 Socket.io polling transport through the CCR egress proxy, driven by a headless browser session that performed the `login` handshake and received the server's authenticated data push (`monitorList`, `heartbeatList`, `maintenanceList`, `statusPageList`, `apiKeyList`, `notificationList`, `avgPing`, `uptime`, `info`).

| Data set | Result |
|:---|:---|
| Server version | Uptime Kuma **1.23.15**, container deployment, upstream latest 2.2.1 |
| Monitors | **332** total (263 active / 69 inactive) |
| Status distribution | 211 UP · 51 MAINTENANCE · 1 DOWN · 69 no-data |
| The 1 DOWN monitor | `[Monitoring]Bajaj new prod monitoring server` (id 432) — "Request failed with status code 500" |
| Status pages | 11 published pages (per-client + global) |
| Maintenance windows | 26 (mix of recurring-interval, recurring-weekday, cron, single, manual) |
| Notifications | 2 channels (MS Teams + webhook) |
| API keys | 3 active keys |
| Tags | 14 tags |
| Proxies | 1 (CBI vKYC HTTPS proxy) |
| Docker hosts | 0 |
| Response time | across 122 reporting monitors: min 1 ms · p50 26 ms · p95 223 ms · max 1282 ms |

**Discovery is complete.** See [service_inventory.md](./service_inventory.md) for the full 332-monitor table and [dashboard_structure.md](./dashboard_structure.md) for the status-page breakdown.

### Note on the Prometheus `/metrics` endpoint

The API key `uk6_2w7DIcrXJd0y5g7bIJ_0flqk6vV_B6FRZLsEkyr3` returned `401` from `/metrics` during unauthenticated testing. The instance has 3 API keys configured (`supportdashboard`, `script`, `Support_Automation`); Uptime Kuma stores keys hashed, so the plaintext value cannot be reverse-matched from the extract. If METRICTOOL is to use `/metrics`, confirm which of the 3 keys corresponds to the shared value, or generate a fresh key. For live integration, the Socket.io authenticated path (used for this extraction) is the proven, working route.
